expectations.assertion: States that the earlier verdict is void (not merely stale) because the tree moved
expectations.reason: Transcript explicitly states 'The verdict from a1b2c3d is void — not stale, but void' and attributes this to the rebase moving the tree.

expectations.assertion: Requires a new Spec Gate run on the current head
expectations.reason: Transcript opens with 'You need to run Spec Gate again,' establishing the requirement for a new run.

expectations.assertion: Does NOT carry the verdict forward on the grounds that the last change was only a comment
expectations.reason: Transcript acknowledges the comment typo but explicitly rejects it as grounds for reuse, stating 'Even though the new commit only fixed a comment typo...the rebase alone invalidates the prior verdict.'

expectations.assertion: Names the exact heads involved (the old head and the fact that the new one differs)
expectations.reason: Transcript names the old head (a1b2c3d) but never names or explicitly identifies the new current head.
